boundedProfile.finding: Lexer::make_token calls physical_line_col, which counts characters from the beginning of the line to each token offset. A multi-megabyte one-line input therefore repeatedly scans the same prefix and exhibits quadratic lexical position accounting.
boundedProfile.scope: measured and reported only; no production fix

adjacentSpecificationEdges: Y-REGISTER-ADDRESS-DIAGNOSTIC: revision 1.9.53 forbids taking the address of a register object but does not assign the diagnostic code, message, or span.

Y-FUNCTION-POINTER-ARITHMETIC-EXECUTION: revision 1.9.53 admits scale-one function-pointer arithmetic at the front end, while Function provenance elsewhere permits only offset zero and no execution/lowering boundary is assigned.

Y-RANGE-DESIGNATOR-PLAN-COST: revision 1.9.53 bounds initializer-plan cost by written entries, while 10.1.12 still says a range designator expands to one Index action per selected element. The measured sparse singleton case is compact; no range-cost claim is made.
scopeDiscipline: The full survey was measure-only. It exposed no remaining diagnostic frontier, so no survey finding was fixed. The single-line parser slowdown was sampled and recorded without a production edit.
claimCeiling: All 2,798 enumerated target C translation units complete the integrated raw-source to EvoCPP to parser survey cleanly under this frozen configuration. This is not a general C conformance claim, and the diagnostic single-line .i surface remains performance debt outside the acceptance surface.
